content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement language appears anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: Section 9.2 No Transfer or Lien by Depositor. Except for the transfer and assignment under this Agreement, the Depositor will not transfer or assign any Depositor Transferred Property to another Person or Grant or allow a Lien, other than a Permitted Lien, on an interest in any Depositor Transferred Property.
input.rationale: This transfer and servicing agreement contains no employee non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement covenant. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce" and "personnel" returned no hits, and the only "employee" references are limited-recourse/no-recourse-against-personnel provisions (p0244, p0284), indemnity definitions (p0291) and ERISA/Benefit Plan definitions (p0649, p0651, p0740, p0770) — none of which restrict hiring. Article IX ("Other Agreements") contains only financing statement, no-transfer/lien, expense, no-petition, limited recourse, tax and cap collateral covenants, with no restrictive covenants on personnel; Article VII's successor servicer transition provisions likewise impose no hiring restriction on the Issuer, Depositor or any Successor Servicer. Because the playbook's preferred position is that no non-solicit bind the Customer, the absence of any such covenant meets the preferred position and no redline is warranted.
